title: potentilla reptans f. adscendens
intro: Potentilla reptans f. adscendens, commonly known as creeping cinquefoil, is a variety of the Potentilla reptans plant, a member of the rose family (Rosaceae). It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for treating wounds, infections, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of creeping cinquefoil include soothing and calming the skin, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
